arcs.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
arcs.summary: Day 3: The working group's preliminary notes on the Diagon Alley puddle contain a footnote referencing 'vault-adjacent drainage channels (see Annex C, pending).' Annex C does not exist. Christine has read the full paper, noted the footnote, and placed a blank sheet of Gringotts-headed notepaper on her desk. Prentice-Hoole has confirmed nothing and promised Annex D, which also does not exist. Tibbs has read the paper and chosen not to have an opinion. Day 4 (resolution): the Committee should formally and somewhat obliviously approach Gringotts on the drainage question; Christine should resolve the matter in a single meeting, possibly before Prentice-Hoole finishes his opening remarks; the blank notepaper should play a role; the Committee should be left technically intact but effectively redirected. Warm, swift, and final.
